cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We were both laid off, but you need a proper cup of tea. Sit down, please. I'll get the tissues open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These soft ones are for you. Feet on the floor, please; curling up won't help. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. Your hands are shaking so much you can't open the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then hold it steady while I pull. Not that end, the perforation. We'll get you a tissue. Please keep holding it; I can't quite make my fingers work.

reason: Make A direct comfort technique while B's concern exposes worsening motor distress; the shared task still serves B despite A's need.
